name: Aoze 1.1.0
bodyHtml:
Aoze 1.1.0: Aoze now keeps itself up to date.

New

  • Updates: Aoze tells you when a new version is out and installs it in one click, then reopens.
  • What's new: after an update, a short list of the changes, shown once.
  • Settings: turn the update check off, or check now. The installed version is shown at the bottom of the sidebar.

Improved

  • Every update is checked before it is installed: official GitHub release only, Aoze's signature and SHA-256. Your current version stays untouched until the new one is ready.

Download Aoze_1.1.0_x64-setup.exe, run it, done (FFmpeg and every engine are included).
Aoze 1.1.0 and later update themselves: they offer the new version when it is out.
The installer is per-user (no admin rights). It is not code-signed yet, so Windows SmartScreen
may show "Windows protected your PC": choose "More info", then "Run anyway".
